name: Simplatform
summary: Simplatform Co., Ltd. is a South Korean company specializing in providing AIoT solutions through a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) model. Their primary offering, NUBISON AIoT, is an industrial SaaS platform that integrates Internet of Things (IoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies with comprehensive management and operational services. This platform enables clients to leverage SaaS for various applications, including predictive maintenance, quality inspection, manufacturing optimization, supply chain streamlining, resource management, and product servicing. Founded in 2011, Simplatform's operations are headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
